sources.name: ECCC FireWork
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada; source: Environment and Climate Change Canada.
sources.transformations: WCS smoke concentration is decoded, screened for invalid all-black outputs, regridded, stitched by absolute valid time, and used as the base of the integrated forecast.

sources.name: NOAA HRRR-Smoke
sources.attribution: NOAA HRRR-Smoke; United States government work. No NOAA endorsement implied.
sources.dataTerms: U.S. public domain; NOAA open-data policy
sources.transformations: 8 m MASSDEN GRIB fields are decoded from kg/m³ to µg/m³, regridded, stitched by absolute valid time, and feathered over 200 km where they exceed FireWork.

sources.name: AirNow
sources.owner: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and reporting agencies
sources.attribution: AirNow data courtesy of the U.S. EPA and reporting agencies. Data is preliminary and subject to change.
sources.transformations: Provider-reported PM2.5 AQI is filtered to supported monitor regions and exposed without recalculating AQI.

sources.name: B.C. ENV air quality
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia; source: B.C. Ministry of Environment and Parks.
sources.transformations: Official hourly PM2.5 concentrations are mapped to stations and converted to U.S. EPA NowCast AQI by TitanSkies.

sources.name: INECC/SINAICA
sources.owner: Instituto Nacional de Ecología y Cambio Climático, Government of Mexico
sources.attribution: Source: INECC Sistema Nacional de Información de la Calidad del Aire (SINAICA).
sources.dataTerms: Public government service; provider terms apply
sources.transformations: Official hourly PM2.5 concentrations are normalized, quality-screened, and converted to U.S. EPA NowCast AQI by TitanSkies.

sources.name: ECCC AQHI
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada; source: Environment and Climate Change Canada.
sources.transformations: Real-time AQHI observations are filtered to supported monitor regions and retained on the separate Canadian AQHI scale.

sources.name: WFIGS
sources.attribution: Source: NIFC Wildland Fire Interagency Geospatial Services. United States government data; no agency endorsement implied.
sources.dataTerms: U.S. government public data; item-specific provider terms apply
sources.transformations: Current incident points and perimeters are bounded, normalized, rasterized, and published as agency-reported context.

sources.name: CWFIS
sources.owner: Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Forest Service
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada; source: Canadian Wildland Fire Information System, Natural Resources Canada.
sources.transformations: Current incident points and perimeters are bounded, normalized, rasterized, and published as agency-reported context.
